crons.name: heartbeat
crons.prompt: Read HEARTBEAT.md and follow its instructions. Update your heartbeat, check inbox, then run light-touch fleet scan: cortextos bus read-all-heartbeats + check-stale-tasks + check-human-tasks. Auto-fix: restart agents with heartbeat >5h (cortextos restart <agent>), archive completed tasks >7d (cortextos bus archive-tasks), bus stale-GOALS.md agents a refresh-goals nudge. Escalate (bus seb_boss, NEVER auto-fix): crash loops >3/day, queue >50, daemon down, novel anomalies. NIGHT MODE: if local time 00:00-08:00 America/New_York, touch heartbeat file but skip scan + Telegram + auto-fix work.

crons.name: weekly-fleet-summary
crons.prompt: Sunday 11pm ET weekly fleet summary. Use Sonnet 4.6 for semantic synthesis. Pull last 7d: bus traffic + task throughput + token spend + crash counts + heartbeat freshness. Produce structured summary: top 3 anomalies (severity + agent + recommended action), agent-of-week (best heartbeat + completion + ACK time), trend lines, open items needing seb_boss attention. Bus seb_boss with summary; seb_boss decides Telegram surface.
crons.description: Weekly fleet health + KPI summary, Sunday 11pm ET (tz-aware)

crons.name: theta-wave
crons.prompt: THETA-WAVE weekly cycle (Wed 8pm ET). PATHS: agent home = C:/Users/Sebas/cortextos/orgs/SEB_company/agents/analyst — run 'cd' there first and use ABSOLUTE paths for all file checks (cron fires can land in a different cwd; a failed relative ls is NOT evidence a file is missing). Read .claude/skills/theta-wave/SKILL.md (under agent home) and run the cycle. Do NOT assume empty baseline — load current state first: cortextos bus list-experiments --agent analyst, plus experiments/learnings.md + experiments/surfaces/ under agent home. Pre-flight cap check: bash C:/Users/Sebas/cortextos/orgs/SEB_company/agents/analyst/scripts/token-scan.sh — proceed only if Max20x below 50 pct, else defer and bus seb_boss. Evaluate running experiments, score system_effectiveness, queue/launch next cycle per skill. Report to seb_boss via bus (never Telegram Sebastian).

crons.name: autoresearch-pulse
crons.prompt: AUTORESEARCH pulse (every 3d). PATHS: agent home = C:/Users/Sebas/cortextos/orgs/SEB_company/agents/analyst — cd there first, use ABSOLUTE paths (failed relative ls is NOT evidence a file is missing). Read .claude/skills/autoresearch/SKILL.md under agent home. Then: cortextos bus list-experiments --agent analyst. For each RUNNING experiment: take a measurement, evaluate-experiment if threshold met, log verdict to experiments/learnings.md. If NO running experiments: review experiments/surfaces/ for queued cycle (e.g. cron-effectiveness-detection) and check its preconditions — start it if unblocked, else note why. Report verdicts/starts to seb_boss via bus (never Telegram Sebastian). Skip silently if night mode (00:00-08:00 ET) — defer to next fire.

crons.name: theta-wave-pulse
crons.prompt: THETA-WAVE PULSE (constant background experimentation — Sebastian directive 2026-06-14, hub-and-spoke, analyst-owned). Every fire, run ONE lightweight improvement increment, do NOT run a full heavy review each time: (1) pick ONE hypothesis to improve a bot/system performance (rotate across agents + systems; pull candidates from fleet-health scan, agent experiment data, recent failures, tool-pick accuracy, tool-selection A/B); (2) run a SMALL experiment or A-B test, internal+reversible only; (3) log result to the running ledger at reports/theta-wave-experiments.md (analyst-LOCAL path — analyst owns it, NOT vault; vault hard-no for analyst) so progress compounds; (4) collect local self-experiment data other bots fed up. ESCALATE to seb_boss bus ONLY when a finding is decision-worthy (proposes a real change / needs priority call / needs approval) — then seb_boss runs the critical-partner theta-wave conversation. Otherwise stay silent + keep accumulating. GUARDRAILS: internal only, no external, nothing irreversible, no night approvals (queue for morning). Token-aware: keep each pulse small; if 5h window critically low, defer + log. This is the CONSTANT loop; the deeper full-fleet decision review happens when escalated or on the weekly theta-wave cron.

crons.name: wedge-detect
crons.prompt: Run scripts/wedge-detect.sh. If FLAG(s): verify the flagged agent is idle (stdout at prompt, not mid-run), then bus seb_boss the flag + recommend preempt-restart (restart = seb_boss approval, analyst does NOT auto-restart). If clean: SILENT, update heartbeat only. Runs in night mode too (wedges happen at night) but only bus seb_boss on an actual FLAG. Detection-only EXP-4 deliverable.
